name: Choux Paste
summary: Cooked paste, dried on the heat, raised entirely by steam.

steps.text: Boil water, butter, sugar and salt. Add flour all at once.
Cook the paste on the heat until it films the pan base.
Cool to warm, then beat in egg gradually to a V-shaped ribbon.
Pipe and bake without opening the oven.

bake.notes: Drop to 175°C after 15 minutes. Opening the door early collapses them.

notes: Drying the paste properly matters more than the egg quantity.
